#  Pull Request Plan

> Every PR — human or agent — starts with intent. Copilot's PRs usually fill
> this in; the plan-gate workflow blocks any PR that doesn't. If the plan
> changes mid-review, update this description.

## Plan (required)

- **Goal:**
- **Scope (paths/files):**
- **Steps:**
  1.
  2.
- **Success criteria (verifiable):**
  - [ ] CI (`npm test`, `npm run build`) passes
  - [ ] New behavior has new tests
  - [ ] No unrelated files changed
- **Risks + mitigations:**
- **Rollback / escalation plan:**

## Evidence

- Workflow run(s):
- Code scanning (if applicable):

## Review checklist

- [ ] Plan matches the diff
- [ ] Scope respected — no drive-by changes
- [ ] Reviewed by the right owner (CODEOWNERS)
